title: Game over?
prompt: The robot's game is over when it has no lives left or the time has run out (zero or less). Return true if it is over.

tests.name: 1 life and a little time: not over

hints: Two ways to lose, joined by or.

docs.what: Comparisons. Each gives true or false.

docs.name: and  or  not
docs.what: and is true when both sides are; or when at least one is; not flips true and false.

solution:
func is_game_over(lives, time_left):
	return lives <= 0 or time_left <= 0
